## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 204 captures during December 2024. Activity was completed as part of the clinic’s routine eye screening service. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the reporting period. Staff should continue to record activity consistently so that operational results can be monitored and any changes in workload or service delivery can be identified.

## Image quality

Of the 204 captures, 5 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.5. The result should be reviewed alongside local equipment and workflow information. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Prompt reporting will support investigation of equipment problems and help reduce avoidable image-quality issues.

## Grading

Grading identified 53 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 15 days. This measure should be monitored with the referable result count to support timely review and follow-up. The clinic should continue to maintain clear records of image capture, grading outcomes, and equipment concerns. These records will assist routine service oversight and provide a basis for addressing any recurring operational issues.
